headline: Pranav Aggarwal jumps to 22nd on ARC-2

sections.text: Pranav Aggarwal gained 35.69 points, moving from 2,622nd to 22nd on the ARC-AGI-2 board.
The jump puts Aggarwal among the board’s leading teams; standings remain provisional.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
